projects.name: Progressive GAN
projects.summary: PyTorch implementation of Progressive GANs for stable, high-quality image synthesis.
description: Implemented Nvidia’s 'Progressive Growing of GANs' in PyTorch, achieving high training stability on Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10.
Published a Pythonic package for ProGAN, simplifying workflows to ~3 lines of code for rapid experimentation.

projects.name: Palette Net
projects.summary: Autoencoder-based image recoloring system that applies custom color palettes to generate diverse, stylized outputs.
description: Built an Autoencoder-based deep learning model to recolor images using custom palettes, generating diverse high-quality variations.
Curated and pre-processed a 40,000-image dataset with augmentation to overcome public data scarcity.
